questions.label: Services
questions.ask: What professional services do you offer?
questions.example: Onboarding: workspace setup, data import from spreadsheets and two training sessions
questions.fills: SOW: Services. SOW and Agreement uses the clickthrough model: the Key Terms are included below and Customer is the company or person who accepts this agreement; SOW Date and Effective Date are the date Customer first accepts.
questions.codebase: Pricing or services pages mentioning onboarding, setup, migration or custom work.

questions.label: Deliverables
questions.ask: Does the customer receive deliverables it will own, and when?
options: Yes, the customer owns them as they are created
Yes, the customer owns them once paid
questions.fills: SOW: Deliverables and Time of Assignment (delete both when none)

questions.label: Third-party materials
questions.ask: Can deliverables include third-party software or content?
questions.fills: SOW: Third-Party Materials (delete when no deliverables)

questions.label: Acceptance
questions.ask: Can the customer reject a deliverable?
options: Reject within 10 business days; we resubmit within 10
Reject within 5 business days; we resubmit within 5
questions.fills: SOW: acceptance process, Rejection and Resubmission Periods

questions.label: Fees
questions.fills: SOW: Fees and travel and expenses
questions.follow_up: Ask for the amount, and whether travel and expenses are billed (at cost, pre-approved) or not at all.

questions.label: Invoicing and payment
questions.ask: How are services invoiced and paid?
options: Invoiced on completion, due in 30 days
Invoiced per milestone, due in 15 days
questions.fills: SOW: Payment Period and Invoice Period

questions.label: SOW length
questions.ask: How long does an SOW run?

questions.label: Customer obligations
questions.ask: What must the customer do for the services to go well?
options: Name a single point of contact
Give timely access to data and systems
Review work and reply within agreed times

questions.label: Liability cap
questions.ask: What is the most either side can owe for most claims?
options: 1x fees paid in the prior 12 months
2x fees paid in the prior 12 months

questions.label: Higher-cap claims
questions.ask: Which claims get a higher cap, and how high?
options: None; the general cap covers everything
Privacy, security and confidentiality breaches at 2x fees
Those breaches plus indemnities at 3x fees
questions.fills: Key Terms: Increased Claims and Increased Cap Amount (delete both when none)

questions.label: Uncapped claims
questions.ask: Which claims have no liability cap at all?
questions.fills: Key Terms: Unlimited Claims (delete when none). Covered Claims keep the template wording; Additional Warranties, Customer Policies and Other Changes are deleted unless the founder names one.

questions.label: Insurance
questions.ask: Which insurance do you promise to carry?
options: General liability, E&O and cyber, $1M each
questions.fills: Key Terms: Insurance Minimums (delete when none). DPA row links the published DPA when one exists, otherwise it is deleted.
